text:
marta_cs: Quick QBR check-in for Sprigly — exec slot next Fri 10:00am PT. Need owners for slides, a short risk blurb on renewal, and a demo fallback. Keeping this fast.

devon_pm: On it. Do we have a single slide deck or separate reps?

marta_cs: Single deck. Outline: 1) Account health + metrics (1 slide) 2) Onboarding status + gaps (1 slide) 3) Demo + fallback (1 slide) 4) Renewal signal & asks (1 slide) 5) Exec summary (1 slide).

alex_eng: Demo readiness: app demo works against staging but we need sanitized prod samples for the key flows. I can scrub and export a stripped dataset tonight.

alex_eng: ```
# scrub script (example)
python tools/scrub_export.py --src s3://sprigly-prod/logs --out demo/sample.json --anonymize
```

tia_support: Onboarding update: customer has completed 6 of 7 enablement sessions. Outstanding: "Custom intents" deep dive — scheduled Wed 3pm PT. NPS from enablement threads is 7.8.

sam_sales: Renewal chatter: champion is positive but procurement flagged pricing. I rate risk as medium-high if we don't land a clear ROI slide. Might need an exec-stacked ask (discount + extended training).

marta_cs: Slide owners (proposed): health = tia_support, onboarding gaps = marta_cs, demo = alex_eng, renewal ask = sam_sales, exec summary = marta_cs. Can everyone confirm? Due EOD Wed for first draft.

devon_pm: Confirmed. I'll assemble deck and drop link here by EOD Tue. Using the QBR template v3.

qbr_bot: Reminder: QBR template v3 uploaded to /company/qbr/templates (version: v3.1). Use it for slide ordering.

alex_eng: Demo fallback: recorded walkthrough + screenshots exported to drive: https://drive.company/sprigly/demo_assets — will add timestamps to jump to key flows.

tia_support: Feedback capture: please paste top 3 customer quotes + support ticket IDs into this doc: https://docs.company/sprigly-feedback. Also sending a short survey link to the champion (I drafted it, see link).

sam_sales: I can own the ROI appendix — need 2 datapoints from product usage (avg tokens/day, conversion uplift). Alex, can you send usage snippet?

alex_eng: Sending PAT query now — will paste numbers in thread by EOD.

marta_cs: Action summary: 1) Slide drafts due EOD Wed (owners as assigned). 2) Demo assets + fallback recorded demo — alex by Tue EOD. 3) Onboarding gap deep dive — tia leads Wed 3pm PT (customer call confirmed). 4) ROI datapoints — alex + sam by Wed. 5) Exec ask draft (pricing + enablement offer) — sam + marta by Thu noon. 6) Deck assembled by devon by Thu 5pm for dry-run Fri morning.

devon_pm: I'll schedule dry-run calendar for Fri 8:30am PT. Invite: execs + eng + cs + sales.

sam_sales: I'll set a quick pre-call 1:1 with the champion to surface procurement blockers — proposing Wed 11am PT.

marta_cs: Thanks all. If you add anything to the deck, preface slide title with [SPRIGLY] so I can quickly review. Ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
